title: Verify Jev scorecard live on sentiment dataset
description: Smoke ~50 items then test split; confirm request count equals item count and accuracy matches research.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live verification on the public sentiment dataset: 50-item smoke and full 3,521-item test split each sent exactly one request per item; Choice accuracy 0.758 (research 0.761); 35/3521 answers differ from the earlier run (model nondeterminism). Script: scripts/jev_scorecard_smoke.py. Left open until the change is committed.
